paper.ca_use_tip: Put this number in the open student's points box
paper.ca_stick_tip: Click where it goes on the paper
paper.ca_pct_none: Type a score to see its percent.
paper.snip_drag: Drag over what you want to copy.
paper.snip_drag_page: Drag over what you want to copy, or click a page for all of it.
paper.snip_note_paper: On the paper, name covers are painted in and the student’s name and file names are left off. Anything else shows as it is on screen.
paper.snip_note: Everything shows as it is on screen.
paper.snip_miss_paper: Drag over an area, or click a page.
paper.snip_miss: Drag over an area to copy it.
paper.snip_fail: That picture couldn’t be made. Try a smaller area.
paper.snip_copied: Picture copied. Paste it wherever you need it.
paper.snip_saved: This browser can’t copy pictures, so it was saved as Screenshot.png.
paper.tn_bank_none: No saved comments yet. Save one under the comment, or add them in Settings > Marking.
paper.gs_looking: Looking for the grade on each paper…
paper.gs_help: Every row is made from the file named on it, inside that student’s folder. Click a picture to open that student. Click a score to copy it.
paper.gs_also: Also show grades found on the papers (a score you gave in Grading Studio always counts)
paper.gs_all: Show files with no grade (the downloaded sheet shows the same rows)
paper.gs_trim: Trim each spot down to your marks

paper.gs_out.one: {n} file has no marks, so it’s left out as an extra paper.
paper.gs_out.other: {n} files have no marks, so they’re left out as extra papers.

paper.gs_many: This paper has more than one grade on it, so say which one to use.
paper.gs_type_tip: Type the score you see in the picture
paper.gs_not_all: Not every criterion is highlighted yet
paper.gs_no_stamp: No score stamp on this paper yet. Use Stamp by the total to put your score on it.
paper.gs_seen: No grade in the typed text found: “{text}”
paper.gs_flat: There are marks here but no typed text, so the grade may be handwritten or flattened. Try Box it by hand.
paper.gs_blank: No marks or typed text in this file. If it was marked in Kami, the marks may not have been saved into the file. Try Box it by hand.
paper.gs_yours_is: Your score in Grading Studio is {v}
paper.gs_cant_open: This file couldn’t be opened. Click Skip.
paper.gs_box_help: Drag a box around the grade. It saves and goes to the next paper. Left and right arrows go back and on; Esc finishes.
paper.gs_box_again: already boxed (drag again to change it)
paper.gs_spot_help: Drag a box around where you put the grade. The same spot gets cropped on every paper, which also catches handwritten grades.

paper.g_check.one: {n} paper to check: its own grade differs from yours, or it has more than one grade, or one that may not be the grade.
paper.g_check.other: {n} papers to check: their own grade differs from yours, or they have more than one grade, or one that may not be the grade.

paper.cs_h_drift: Did you get harder or softer as you went?

paper.cs_few_n.one: Only {n} paper has a time to go by so far.
paper.cs_few_n.other: Only {n} papers have a time to go by so far.

paper.cs_few_none: No papers have a time to go by so far.
paper.cs_few_min: It takes at least {n} before this will say anything about getting harder or softer. Any pattern in fewer is mostly chance.
paper.cs_nums: Your first {k} papers average about {a} and your last {k} about {b}, out of {max}.
paper.cs_none_few: With {n} papers only a big change would show, so this doesn't prove you stayed even.
paper.cs_none_chance: A gap that size often happens by chance.

paper.cs_lower.one: Later papers scored lower, by about {n} point.
paper.cs_lower.other: Later papers scored lower, by about {n} points.

paper.cs_higher.one: Later papers scored higher, by about {n} point.
paper.cs_higher.other: Later papers scored higher, by about {n} points.

paper.cs_why_lower: It could mean you got harder as you went, or just that those papers were weaker. Look at a few early and late papers with the same score.
paper.cs_why_higher: It could mean you got softer as you went, or just that those papers were stronger. Look at a few early and late papers with the same score.
paper.cs_hint_h: Maybe, but it's too soon to be sure.
paper.cs_hint: With {n} papers this could easily be chance.
paper.cs_likely: That's bigger than chance usually makes with {n} papers.
paper.cs_rows_few: Rubric rows aren't read one by one with fewer than {n} papers: each row is too noisy on its own.
paper.cs_row_few: too few papers with a time

paper.cs_row_lower.one: later papers lower, by about {n} point
paper.cs_row_lower.other: later papers lower, by about {n} points

paper.cs_row_higher.one: later papers higher, by about {n} point
paper.cs_row_higher.other: later papers higher, by about {n} points

paper.cs_foot: This goes by when each score last changed, so a paper you came back to counts as late. Finished scores only.

paper.cs_no_time.one: {n} has no time (scored before the app kept them, or read off the paper)
paper.cs_no_time.other: {n} have no time (scored before the app kept them, or read off the paper)

paper.cs_at_once: {n} changed all at once, like feedback brought back from an assistant, so their order isn't known
paper.cs_chart: Scores in the order you gave them. The same scores are in the list under the chart.
paper.cs_h_same: The same score, side by side
paper.cs_pick: Pick a score to see those papers next to each other.
paper.cs_single: Scores with just one paper aren't listed.
paper.cs_none_same: No two papers share a finished score yet.
paper.cs_no_pdf: No PDF or picture to show here. Open the paper to read it.
paper.an_tip: The high, middle and low paper your school keeps from a summative. Return exports all three, named and with names covered.
paper.an_on: This is the {lv} paper. Click again to take it off.
paper.an_move: Make this the {lv} paper instead of {who}
paper.an_move_anon: Make this the {lv} paper instead of another paper
paper.an_set: {lv} anchor paper. It's on Return, ready to export.
paper.an_pick: Pick a high, middle and low paper while you mark: under the score, click High, Mid or Low.

paper.an_files.other: Files come out as “{name}”, {n} in one ZIP.

paper.an_cover_say: Typed names and your own cover boxes are blacked out. A handwritten name needs a cover box of its own.
paper.an_plain: Names stay as they are on the paper.
paper.an_saved_n: Saved {n} anchor papers in one ZIP.
paper.an_first: Pick a high, middle or low paper first
paper.hn_on: Names hidden: papers in a random order, names covered
paper.hn_no_pdf: No PDFs or pictures to check.
paper.hn_p1: Papers show as Paper 1, Paper 2… in a random order. Scores still go to the right student.
paper.hn_cover: In Check the covers, drag a box over a name, then use it on every paper.

paper.hn_word_on.one: This paper may show a name.
paper.hn_word_on.other: These papers may show a name.

paper.hn_word_turn.one: Turn it into PDF pages to cover it.
paper.hn_word_turn.other: Turn them into PDF pages to cover them.

paper.hn_shuf_start: Shuffle a new order and start
paper.cc_none: No PDFs or pictures to check

paper.cc_every_done.one: Added that cover to {n} more paper
paper.cc_every_done.other: Added that cover to {n} more papers

paper.cc_took: Cover taken off. {key} puts it back.
paper.cc_hint: Drag over a name to cover it. Click a box to take it off. {key} undoes.
paper.cc_every: Use my last box on every paper
paper.pw_note_name: This name isn’t a clear match on the {cls} roster, so past work can’t be matched for sure.
paper.pw_note_noroster: No roster is picked for this download, so past work can’t be matched for sure.
paper.pw_noscore: No score in the app. The paper may have one.
paper.pw_why_close: The name is close, but it isn’t a sure match.
paper.pw_why_other: The same name, but in {cls}. It may be someone else.
paper.pw_why_none: The same name, but no roster to confirm it.
paper.pw_hidden: Its scores stay hidden until you say.
paper.ib_about: Tick the criteria you are marking on this task. Each becomes a row scored 0 to {top}. A task usually assesses two or three.
paper.ib_note: What each level means on a row is yours to write: use Rubric setup afterwards and paste your own descriptors.

paper.ib_lose.one: The levels or score already given on {n} paper go. Undo brings them back.
paper.ib_lose.other: The levels or scores already given on {n} papers go. Undo brings them back.

paper.ib_stamp_tip: Put the levels on the paper: {text}
paper.sh_say: This makes a ZIP you can give to {ai} with no names in it. Each student gets a random code, and the list of who is who stays only in this browser.
paper.sh_w1: Every page becomes a picture, so no hidden text or file details go with it.
paper.sh_w2: Names are covered where you box them in Check the covers.
paper.sh_w2_find: Names are covered in black wherever they are typed on the page, and so are email addresses and long ID numbers.
paper.sh_w3: Your scores, rubric and comments go too, with names swapped for [name].
paper.sh_w4: Only PDFs and pictures go in. A Word file stays out until it is PDF pages.

paper.sh_out.one: Not in the ZIP: 1 student with no paper that can go in.
paper.sh_out.other: Not in the ZIP: {n} students with no paper that can go in.

paper.sh_s1_say: Drag a box over each name. If names are in the same spot, box it once and use it on every paper.
paper.sh_stays: It stays on your computer until you give it to {ai}.
paper.sh_s3: Give it to {ai}, with this message. Change it however you like.
paper.sh_copied: Copied. Paste it into {ai} along with the ZIP.
paper.sh_mk_copied: Copied. Paste it into {ai} along with the marks file.
paper.sh_copy_failed: Couldn't copy. Select the text and copy it yourself.
paper.sh_making: Covering names and making pictures {n} of {of}
paper.sh_made: Done. Give the ZIP to {ai}, then use Bring back with what it sends.
paper.sh_mk_say: One file for spotting patterns across the class, with no names in it. Students get the same codes as in the ZIP, and names in your comments become [name]. No papers go, so there are no covers to check.
paper.sh_mo_scores: Rubric scores, total, percent and status
paper.sh_mo_comments: Your comments and text on the page
paper.sh_mo_words: The words you highlighted, circled or commented on
paper.sh_mo_ink: A count of pen marks and checks
paper.sh_mk_s3: Bring the reply back, if it wrote feedback for students.

paper.sh_mk_made.one: Done: 1 student. Give the file to {ai} with the message.
paper.sh_mk_made.other: Done: {n} students. Give the file to {ai} with the message.

paper.bb_say: Paste {ai}'s reply here, or open the file it gave you (CSV, text or ZIP). Each code is matched to its student in this browser.
paper.bb_add: Add below what's already in the comment box (untick to replace it)
paper.bb_more: Copy a note asking {ai} for these
paper.bb_more_ask: Please continue with feedback for these codes, in the same format: {codes}

paper.bb_name_left.one: 1 reply still says [name]. Change it to the student's name in the comment box, or leave it out.
paper.bb_name_left.other: {n} replies still say [name]. Change it to the student's name in the comment box, or leave it out.

paper.bb_not_here.one: 1 code doesn't belong to this assignment.
paper.bb_not_here.other: {n} codes don't belong to this assignment.

paper.bb_read_over: Read it over before you put it in.

paper.bb_papers_n.one: 1 paper named by code can be sorted back into student folders.
paper.bb_papers_n.other: {n} papers named by code can be sorted back into student folders.

paper.bb_none: No codes found yet. Each block should start with a code like S-7QK4.

paper.gs_cp_done.one: Copied {n} score in the list’s order (blank where unsure)
paper.gs_cp_done.other: Copied {n} scores in the list’s order (blank where unsure)

paper.gs_cp_ask.one: {n} student has only part of the rubric scored: {names}. That total isn’t final and says “(partial)” in what you copy. Copy anyway?
paper.gs_cp_ask.other: {n} students have only part of the rubric scored: {names}. Those totals aren’t final and say “(partial)” in what you copy. Copy anyway?
